questions.markdown:
Design a PDA with a transition diagram to accept the following language,

$$
L=\{a^ib^jc^k \mid i,j,k \geq 0,\ i=j\ \text{or}\ j=k\}.
$$

 

Show whether the obtained PDA is deterministic or non-deterministic.

Describe with a diagram the Standard Turing Machine. Then show the situations of the tape before and after the move

$$
\delta(q_0,a)=(q_1,d,R)
$$

i) Describe the RE for the languages over $\Sigma=\{a,b\}$

a. $\{\, w \in \Sigma^* \mid w\ \text{has exactly one pair of consecutive}\ a \,\}$

b. $\{\, w \in \Sigma^* \mid w\ \text{does not end with a pair of consecutive letter} \,\}$

ii) Draw a NFA for the RE $((aa)^*+bb^*)^*$

questions.markdown:
i) Construct an automaton that accepts the language generated by the grammar.

$$
\begin{aligned}
S &\to abA\\
A &\to baB\\
B &\to aA \mid bb
\end{aligned}
$$

ii) Check whether the given grammar is ambiguous or not by using parse trees for the generation of the string $aabbccdd$

$$
\begin{aligned}
S &\to AB\ /\ C\\
A &\to aAb\ /\ ab\\
B &\to cBd\ /\ cd\\
C &\to aCd\ /\ aDd\\
D &\to bDc\ /\ bc
\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the grammar $G$ whose productions are:

$$
\begin{aligned}
S &\to aAS \mid A\\
A &\to SbA \mid SS \mid ba
\end{aligned}
$$

Show that $S \Rightarrow^* aabbaa$ and construct a derivation tree whose yield is $aabbaa$.

Find a grammar in CNF that is equivalent to the following grammar (The only variable here is $S$):

$$
S \to \sim S \mid [S] \mid l \mid p \mid q
$$
reviewNotes: The terminal before S appears as a tilde-like symbol in the source. Transcribed as $\sim$.
The single terminal after the vertical bars appears to be the lowercase letter 'l'; verify from source if needed.

questions.markdown: Design a PDA for accepting a language $\{a^nb^{2n} \mid n \geq 1\}$ with a transition diagram. Specify the corresponding 7 tuple specification.

Find the $S$ grammar to generate the language

$$
L=\{a^nb^n \mid n \geq 1\}
$$

Show that the language

$$
L=\{ww : w \in \{a,b\}^*\}
$$

is not context free using pumping lemma.

Design a Turing Machine using transition function to accept a language

$$
L=\{a^nb^m : n<m\}
$$

where the tape will have $a$, and $b$ as the only input symbols.

Design a transducer with 5 states using transition diagram to generate $ww^R$ from $w$,

where $w \in \{a,b\}^+$. Show the computation of the string $ab$ in the transducer, which after processing will contain $abba$.
Discuss the automata, grammar, and the associated languages with appropriate examples at each level of the Chomsky Hierarchy.
Elaborate on the Enumeration procedure with reference to universal Turing Machine. Discuss the relationship between enumeration procedures and Turing machines with respect to countability
